info.title: Asset Service API
info.description: Asset management endpoints - Create, update, and manage assets WebSocket clustering is Redis-backed, but gateway startup does not wait for Redis; the adapter reconnects automatically and falls back to in-memory mode while Redis is unavailable.

success.description: true = business success; false = handled error in body

data.description: Payload from handler / gRPC (e.g. asset.v1 messages) when success is true

error.description: Error message when success is false (gateway error helper)

message.description: Human-readable message (mainly when success is true)

requestId.description: Echo of x-correlation-id / tracing id when provided

statusCode.description: Optional hint code when returning error object without throwing

isImportant.description: Marks asset as important in UI

items.description: List of items at this location

AssetCreateBody.description: Create asset body — maps to asset.v1 CreateAssetRequest

isEncrypted.description: Whether blob is encrypted at rest

AssetFileRef.description: File reference attached to an asset

AssetUpdateBody.description: Update asset body — maps to asset.v1 UpdateAssetRequest (id from path)

isEncrypted.description: Whether blob is encrypted at rest

AssetFileRef.description: File reference attached to an asset

locationId.description: Location để gán phiên mới cho tài sản

status.description: Trạng thái khởi tạo (mặc định: not_use)

startDateOfUse.description: Ngày bắt đầu sử dụng (epoch ms)

AddAssetLocationBody.description: Thêm tài sản vào location mới kèm giá — v1 add-location

status.description: Item status e.g. not_use, broken, sold

assetStatusId.description: Asset status session id to transfer

CreateAssetTransferBody.description: Tạo phiếu chuyển giao tài sản — CreateAssetTransferRequest

UpdateAssetTransferBody.description: Cập nhật phiếu chuyển giao tài sản — UpdateAssetTransferRequest (id in path)

RespondToAssetTransferBody.description: Phản hồi phiếu chuyển giao tài sản — RespondToAssetTransferRequest (id in path)

mode.description: Vai trò người nhận sau khi đồng bộ phiên

CreateMaintenanceDiscussBody.description: Tạo bình luận/thảo luận trên maintenance task — CreateMaintenanceDiscussRequest

skipHeaderRow.description: If true, first row is treated as header and skipped

items.description: Assets to include in this export

assetId.description: Asset id to include in export bundle

assetIds.description: Asset ids to serialize as CSV rows

name.description: Tên gợi ý (tối thiểu 2 ký tự)

type.description: Loại báo cáo: asset | maintenance | transfer | export
